visualCharacteristics: A responsive grid of brand logo images (6-across on desktop), each wrapped in a link to a category page. No captions or body text — the logo itself is the clickable element.
contentPattern: One row per logo: an image wrapped in (or paired with) a link to the destination category page.
usage: Sale page 'Top-Selling Mattress Brands' logo grid (Stearns & Foster, Sealy, Tempur-Pedic, Serta, Beautyrest, 1885 Collection).
